name: Bolt · Death ×2
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 3 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.75 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 5 s
• Life drain: 1.25 ❤ damage, you heal 0.5 ❤
self_description:
